message: field access `.r` is unsafe on `Shape`: not every constructor declares that field, so a value built by another constructor has no such word to read
label: only some constructors declare this field
notes: an unguarded load on a value of another constructor reads its slot, or a word past its block: this passed `check` and died of SIGSEGV
help: match on the value instead, and read the field in the arm that has it - a `match` emits the tag guard that field access cannot
